name: Nearpane Next · Proposed visual tokens
status: Designed; HTML prototype only; native parity not validated

proposesChanges: one shared workpage presentation for independent data domains
two continuous host surfaces instead of one card per capability

units: CSS px represent logical macOS points in the simulated desktop. Gallery fitting scales the entire desktop uniformly.

geometry.widthBelowReadableThreshold: Use compact/icon presentation; do not overwrite the user's saved width.
geometry.nativeRecommendedHitArea: Use native accessibility controls; visual size is not the complete hit area.
geometry.maximumDefaultWidthNote: No hard cap; default follows 12.5% of display logical width. The prototype only demonstrates displays up to 1920pt.

typography.native: PingFang SC / SF Pro, platform typography

colors.note: Native implementation should use semantic colors and test contrast with real wallpaper and accessibility settings. CSS opacity is not a claim of NSVisualEffectView parity.

motion.reducedMotion: Disable transitional movement; retain state feedback.
